name: Grande Mosquée de Porto-Novo
subtitle: The Grand Mosque is an Afro-Brazilian building with a ceramic minaret, multicoloured walls and a carved wooden door.

facts.label: Appearance
facts.value: ceramic minaret, multicoloured walls, carved wooden door

facts.label: Resemblance to a church
facts.value: the heritage agency head says it looks like a church because the former slaves built churches in Brazil

facts.label: Today
facts.value: a new mosque was built beside it and the older one is a tourist attraction

facts.label: Style and location
facts.value: Afro-Brazilian architecture, located in the grand marché

parts.text: The Grand Mosque is an Afro-Brazilian building with a ceramic minaret, multicoloured walls and a carved wooden door. The head of the city heritage agency says it looks like a church because the former slaves were used to building churches in Brazil; a new mosque now stands beside it.
